decision.observation: The goose is on open grass east of the stump, facing east; the blue can is fully visible on the ground west-southwest of it and is not held.
decision.hypothesis: A shorter sustained west-southwest steer should stop the goose on clear grass just east of the can, rather than overshooting onto the stump roots.
decision.memory: Allow movement to finish before repositioning. Once the can is ahead at lowered-neck range, pre-aim, then hold Control_L and right-click without pointer movement.
